_comment: The SOUNDNESS half of edf_land_aura_unlocks_color_same_turn. A land Aura's bonus is same-turn
supply only if a land survives the Aura's OWN cost still untapped to host it -- and this fixture
is the board where it does not.
Board: a lone untapped Brushland. Hand: two Wild Growths ({G} each). Casting the first taps the
Brushland, which is then the only land there is to enchant -- so its additional {G} cannot arrive
this turn and the second Wild Growth is unpayable. Exactly one is castable.
This is the fixture that says WHERE the Aura credit is allowed to live. Stamping it optimistically
at enumeration (an a.rock_mana-style 'this cast adds {G}') would admit BOTH here, which is the
same unsound-credit shape the etb_untap_lands note in CollectActions records: the enumerator spends
its breadth offering plans whose mana the executor cannot make, and human play gets offered them.
The credit therefore lives in SubsetPayableWithFilters -- a real-payment simulation, where taps
persist across the casts and the host-still-untapped condition holds by construction.
Restore the credit as an enumeration stamp and this fixture goes green-to-red; that is the check
that it DISCRIMINATES rather than merely passing.
